# Veritas Aescula Institute

> Veritas Aescula Institute (VAI) is a fully online school for students in Myanmar and across Southeast Asia who want to study medicine. It offers healthcare-focused OSSD, GED and IGCSE O Level programmes, and ALMA, a Pearson Edexcel International A Level programme in Biology, Chemistry, and Maths or Physics, built for medical school.

## Programmes

- [ALMA – A Levels for Medical Aspirants](https://veritasaescula.com/alma.html): VAI's 18-month, fully online Pearson Edexcel International A Level programme in Biology, Chemistry, and Maths or Physics, built for one goal: medical school in Europe, China, Southeast Asia and around the world. It covers the full specification and the same official Pearson exams. The first cohort runs from January 2027 to June 2028. Biology and Chemistry start in January 2027 and the third subject in June 2027. Biology and Chemistry are examined in the October 2027 series, with results in January 2028, just as applications open; the third subject is examined in May/June 2028, with results in August 2028. All three subjects appear on one combined certificate, subject to Pearson Edexcel's certification requirements. Exams are sat at the British Council exam centre in Myanmar, or at the Pearson centre in Bangkok for students in Thailand. Strong A Level grades can replace the entrance exam at a number of medical schools; where a university still tests, CSCA, IMAT and EU entrance-exam preparation, personal statements and MMI interview practice are in the timetable, with weekly timed tests and a full mock before every exam series. O Level and Grade 11 finishers enter directly; Grade 10 and GED finishers enter after a Diagnostic Placement Exam and Structured Admissions Interview, with the 6–12-month A Level Foundation (AF) if required.
- [A Level Foundation (AF)](https://veritasaescula.com/alma.html#foundation): Formerly called the GED → ALMA Bridge. A 6-, 9- or 12-month online foundation course for GED holders, sized by a diagnostic, that closes the gaps between the GED and A Level: algebra and trigonometry, quantitative chemistry, precise biology and A Level exam technique. Students then join ALMA, so the whole route takes about 24–30 months. Unique to VAI.
- [Program Highlights](https://veritasaescula.com/#programs): The four programmes side by side — Ontario Secondary School Diploma (OSSD), GED, IGCSE O Level and ALMA.
- [IGCSE O Level to Medical School](https://veritasaescula.com/#igcse-pathway): Why IGCSE O Level alone is rarely enough for direct Year 1 medical entry, and how students bridge to a full secondary diploma.

## ALMA: medical schools where A Level grades can replace the entrance exam

Requirements as published on each university's website for 2026/27 entry, checked October 2026. Places are competitive and rules change every year; VAI confirms each student's shortlist individually.

- [Charles University, Second Faculty of Medicine](https://www.lf2.cuni.cz/en/applicants/how-to-apply/exemptions) (Czech Republic): entrance exam waived for up to 25 applicants a year (apply by 30 April); AAA in Biology, Chemistry, and Physics or Maths.
- [University of Szeged](https://u-szeged.hu/english/study-programmes/general-medicine-md) (Hungary): entrance exam waived; predicted grades give a conditional place; A in two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics, plus a pass in a third A Level.
- [University of Thessaly](https://medical.edu.gr/admission-fees/) (Greece): admission test waived, with an online interview; AAB in Biology, Chemistry and one other subject (not English); final results only.
- [Lithuanian University of Health Sciences (LSMU)](https://lsmu.lt/en/admission/admission-process/) (Lithuania): entrance test waived with A Level Biology and Chemistry, minimum grade C in each.

## Why families choose VAI

- Focused on healthcare and medical school admission, rather than a general curriculum.
- OSSD, GED, IGCSE O Level and International A Levels (ALMA) under one school.
- Built for students in Myanmar and Southeast Asia, with live online classes.
- Structured clinical volunteer hours in Mandalay, Yangon and Bangkok.
- Admissions guidance for medical universities in Europe, Asia and Canada, planned for each student.
- Advanced Biology, Chemistry and medical terminology in the curriculum.
- Graduates accepted to medical universities, including in the Czech Republic (see Success Stories).

## Admissions

- [Scholarships: 2027 Med Aspirant Discount (MAD)](https://veritasaescula.com/#scholarships): USD 5,600 off OSSD tuition for students who join the December 2026 intake and will sit a medical school entrance exam in early 2027. There are 11 places. Applicants apply online, take the VAI Diagnostic Test, and successful applicants receive a personal MAD coupon code to use at enrolment. Terms and conditions apply.
- [Pre-register or apply for the scholarship](https://veritasaescula.com/apply.html): One online form for pre-registration (OSSD, GED, IGCSE O Level, ALMA) and for the Med Aspirant Discount.
- [How to Apply](https://veritasaescula.com/how-to-apply.html): The enrolment steps and the VAI Diagnostic Exam, a placement and scholarship assessment in English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
- [OSSD Course Planner](https://veritasaescula.com/course-planner.html): An interactive planner for choosing OSSD Grade 12 courses by stream and seeing which university pathways they open.
